# Feature Engineering

```{r data manipulation 1, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# CHANNEL NAME SYSTEM
journey <- journey %>%
  mutate(channel = fct_recode(channel,
                              "GD" = "Google Display",
                              "GS" = "Google Search",
                              "FO" = "Organic",
                              "FD" = "Direct",
                              "GY" = "Youtube",
                              "MI" = "Instagram",
                              "MF" = "Facebook",
                              "FE" = "Email Marketing")) # Codename: 1st Letter = Group, 2nd Letter = Channel
# CHANNEL JOURNEY (WHOLE)
journey <- setDT(journey)
journey_wide = data.table::dcast(data = journey, formula = user_id + session_id ~ order, value.var = "channel")
# Clarify that dcast is from "data.table". Assumes "reshape2" if both installed.
journey_wide <- journey_wide[, path:=do.call(paste,c(.SD, sep=" > ")), .SDcols=-c(1,2)]
journey_wide <- journey_wide[, path:=word(path, 1, sep = " > NA")]
journey_wide <- journey_wide %>% select(-c("0":"25"))

# FIRST + LAST CHANNEL
journey_wide <- journey_wide %>% 
  mutate("first_touchpoint" = str_extract(path, "^.."),
         "last_touchpoint" = str_extract(path, "..$"))

# TOTAL JOURNEY TIME
journey <- journey %>%
  filter(order == 0) %>%
  select(-c("order", "channel"))

merge <- inner_join(journey_wide, journey, by = c("user_id", "session_id"))
attribution <- inner_join(merge, results, by = c("user_id", "session_id"))

# TOTAL TOUCHPOINT COUNT
n_touchpoint <- attribution$path %>%
  str_count(">") + 1

attribution$touchpoint_count <- n_touchpoint

# TOTAL CONVERSIONS (from first to current customer journey)
attribution <- attribution %>%
  group_by(user_id) %>%
  mutate(customer_conversion_count = cumsum(conversion == 1),
         customer_journey_count = session_id + 1,
         customer_conversion_rate = round(customer_conversion_count/customer_journey_count, 3),
         returning = n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# FOR FIRST-ORDER MARKOV CHAIN -- Null Conversion
attribution <- attribution %>%
  mutate(null_conversion = 1 - conversion)

# FOR LOGISTIC REGRESSION -- Channel Touchpoint Counts
channels <- c("GD", "GS", "FO", "MI", "MF", "FD", "FE", "GY")

for (channel in channels) {
  attribution[[channel]] <- str_count(attribution$path, paste0("\\b", channel, "\\b"))
}

# Journey Length
attribution <- attribution %>%
  mutate(touchpoint_length = case_when(
    touchpoint_count ==   1                 ~ "Singular",
    touchpoint_count %in% c(2,3)            ~ "Tiny",
    touchpoint_count %in% c(4,5,6)          ~ "Short",
    touchpoint_count %in% c(7,8,9,10)       ~ "Medium",
    touchpoint_count %in% c(11,12,13,14,15) ~ "Long",
    touchpoint_count >    15                ~ "Very Long"))

# Column Relocation
attribution <- attribution %>%
  relocate(null_conversion, .after = conversion) %>%
  relocate(touchpoint_length, .before = customer_conversion_count)

# Remove unecessary elements
rm(journey, journey_wide, results, merge)
```

## Alternative dataframes

```{r collapse function, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# .:!!!WARNING!!!:. TAKES A FEW MINUTES TO RUN .:!!!WARNING!!!:.

# Function for collapsing runs (AI Generated)
collapse_runs <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- x[x != ""]
  x[c(TRUE, x[-1] != x[-length(x)])]
}

# ----------------
# COLLAPSING PATHS
# ----------------

attcol <- attribution %>%
  mutate(path_col = map_chr(
    str_split(path, "\\s*>\\s*"),
    ~ str_c(collapse_runs(.x), collapse = " > "))) %>%
  select(-path, -touchpoint_count, -touchpoint_length,
         -GD, -GS, -FO, -MI, -MF, -FD, -FE, -GY)

# -----------------
# GRANULATING PATHS
# -----------------

channel_groups <- c(GD = "Ggle",
                    GS = "Ggle",
                    FO = "Free",
                    MI = "Meta",
                    MF = "Meta",
                    FD = "Free",
                    FE = "Free",
                    GY = "Ggle")

channels_granulated <- c("Free", "Ggle", "Meta")

attgran <- attribution %>%
  mutate(path_gran = map_chr(
  str_split(path, "\\s*>\\s*"),
  ~ str_c(collapse_runs(unname(channel_groups[str_trim(.x)])),
          collapse = " > "))) %>%
  select(-path, -touchpoint_count, -touchpoint_length,
         -first_touchpoint, -last_touchpoint,
         -GD, -GS, -FO, -MI, -MF, -FD, -FE, -GY)
```

# Model Setup

```{r model start, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

# RELOAD DATA
DataA <- read_csv("C:/Uni26_Sem2/MXB348/WIL/MXB348/data/attribution_full.csv")
DataC <- read_csv("C:/Uni26_Sem2/MXB348/WIL/MXB348/data/attribution_collapsed.csv")
DataG <- read_csv("C:/Uni26_Sem2/MXB348/WIL/MXB348/data/attribution_granulated.csv")
```

```{r Pareto A, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# 80:20 split -- 80% Training & 20% Testing
  # All user sessions kept together.
set.seed(99)
users <- unique(DataA$user_id)
n_train_users <- floor(0.80 * length(users))

# Retry if the random split leaves the test set with only one outcome
for (attempt in 1:1000) {
  train_users <- sample(users, size = n_train_users)

  train_rows <- DataA$user_id %in% train_users
  test_rows  <- !train_rows

  if (length(unique(DataA$conversion[test_rows])) == 2) {
    break
  }
}

if (length(unique(DataA$conversion[test_rows])) < 2) {
  stop("Could not create a test set containing both conversions and non-conversions.")
}

DataA_train <- DataA[train_rows, ]
DataA_test  <- DataA[test_rows, ]

# VALUES
# Conversion Count
total_conversions <- sum(DataA_train$conversion == "1")
# Conversion Rate
conversion_rate <- sum(DataA_train$conversion == "1") / length(DataA_train$conversion)
```

## 4.3.1 Standard

### Heuristic Models

```{r heuristic, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
aHeuristic <- heuristic_models(Data = DataA_train,
                 var_path = "path",
                 var_conv = "conversion",
                 sep =">")

# First-Touch Attribution
aHeuristic$first_touch <- aHeuristic$first_touch / total_conversions * 100

# Last-Touch Attribution
aHeuristic$last_touch <- aHeuristic$last_touch / total_conversions * 100

# Linear Attribution
aHeuristic$linear_touch <- aHeuristic$linear_touch / total_conversions * 100
```

### Data-Driven Models

Logistic Regression

```{r regression, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
Data_Log <- DataA_train %>%
  select(-first_touchpoint,
         -last_touchpoint,
         -time_till_session_end,
         -customer_conversion_count,
         -customer_journey_count,
         -customer_conversion_rate,
         -null_conversion,
         -returning,
         -touchpoint_length)

aLog <- glm(conversion ~ GD + GS + FO + MI + MF + FD + FE + GY,
                 data = DataA_train,
                 family = binomial(link = "logit"))
summary(aLog)

# Significant channels: Search, Organic, Instagram, Facebook, Email

coefficient_names <- c("Intercept", "Display", "Seach",
                       "Organic", "Instagram", "Facebook",
                       "Direct", "Email", "Youtube")

coefficient_names_abv <- c("B0", "GD", "GS", "FO", "MI", "MF", "FD", "FE", "GY")

significant <- c(1, 0, 1, 1, 1 ,1, 0, 1, 0)

aLog_coefficients <- data.frame(name = coefficient_names,
                                name_abv = coefficient_names_abv,
                                coefficient = aLog$coefficients, 
                                significant)

aLog_coefficients <- aLog_coefficients[-1, ] # Removes Intercept Row

# Insignificant channels do not have coefficient = 0 [Display, Direct, Youtube]
aLog_coefficients$coefficient[aLog_coefficients$significant == 0] <- 0 

# Breakdown of math

B_0 = aLog$coefficients[1] # Intercept coefficient

# x = B_0 + B_Ck
# p_ij_hat == path channel count * (1 + exp(-x))^(-1)
Data_Log$GD <- Data_Log$GD * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + aLog_coefficients$coefficient[1])))^(-1)

Data_Log$GS <- Data_Log$GS * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + aLog_coefficients$coefficient[2])))^(-1)

Data_Log$FO <- Data_Log$FO * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + aLog_coefficients$coefficient[3])))^(-1)

Data_Log$MI <- Data_Log$MI * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + aLog_coefficients$coefficient[4])))^(-1)

Data_Log$MF <- Data_Log$MF * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + aLog_coefficients$coefficient[5])))^(-1)

Data_Log$FD <- Data_Log$FD * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + aLog_coefficients$coefficient[6])))^(-1)

Data_Log$FE <- Data_Log$FE * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + aLog_coefficients$coefficient[7])))^(-1)

Data_Log$GY <- Data_Log$GY * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + aLog_coefficients$coefficient[8])))^(-1)

Data_Log <- Data_Log %>%
  mutate(attribution_sum = rowSums(.[6:13]))

# a_ij_hat == p_ij_hat / SUM(p_ir_hat) * y_i [= 1 or 0]
Data_Log$GD <- Data_Log$GD / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$GS <- Data_Log$GS / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$FO <- Data_Log$FO / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$MI <- Data_Log$MI / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$MF <- Data_Log$MF / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$FD <- Data_Log$FD / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$FE <- Data_Log$FE / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$GY <- Data_Log$GY / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

logreg_count <- colSums(Data_Log[,6:13])
logreg_touch <- logreg_count / sum(logreg_count) * 100
show(logreg_touch)

```

First-order Markov Chain

```{r markov, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
markov_array <- markov_model(DataA_train,
                        var_path = 'path',
                        var_conv = 'conversion',
                        var_null = 'null_conversion',
                        out_more = TRUE)

aMarkov <- markov_array$result
aMarkov$all_conversions <- total_conversions
aMarkov$rate <- aMarkov$total_conversions / aMarkov$all_conversions * 100

aModel <- cbind(aHeuristic, aMarkov$rate)

aModel <- aModel %>%
  rename(markov_touch = `aMarkov$rate`)

aTrans <- markov_array$transition_matrix

aTrans$transition_probability <- aTrans$transition_probability * 100
```

Combine

```{r model results, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
ModelRates <- cbind(aModel, logreg_touch)
print(ModelRates)

ModelRates <- ModelRates %>%
  mutate(channel_name = fct_recode(channel_name,
                              "Google Display" = "GD",
                              "Google Search" = "GS",
                              "Organic" = "FO",
                              "Direct" = "FD",
                              "Youtube" = "GY",
                              "Instagram" = "MI",
                              "Facebook" = "MF",
                              "Email Marketing" = "FE"))

model4.3.1 <- cbind(ModelRates[1], stack(ModelRates[2:6]))
print(model4.3.1)

rm(ModelRates, aHeuristic, aMarkov, aLog_coefficients, markov_array, logreg_count,
   logreg_touch, Data_Log, aModel)
```

## 4.3.2a Journey Group

### Heuristic Models

```{r bad, echo = F, message = F}
touchpoint_groups <- DataA_train %>%
  filter(conversion == "1") %>%
  count(touchpoint_length, name = "conversion_count") %>%
  rename(Length = touchpoint_length)

lengths <- c("Singular", "Tiny", "Short", "Medium", "Long", "Very Long")

heuristic_array_lengths <- set_names(lengths) %>%
  map(\(category) {
    DataA_train %>%
      filter(touchpoint_length == category) %>%
      heuristic_models(
        var_path = "path",
        var_conv = "conversion"
      )
  })

aHeuristic_sin <- heuristic_array_lengths$Singular
aHeuristic_tin <- heuristic_array_lengths$Tiny
aHeuristic_sho <- heuristic_array_lengths$Short
aHeuristic_med <- heuristic_array_lengths$Medium
aHeuristic_lon <- heuristic_array_lengths$Long
aHeuristic_vlo <- heuristic_array_lengths$`Very Long`

aHeuristic_sin$Length <- "Singular"
aHeuristic_tin$Length <- "Tiny"
aHeuristic_sho$Length <- "Short"
aHeuristic_med$Length <- "Medium"
aHeuristic_lon$Length <- "Long"
aHeuristic_vlo$Length <- "Very Long"

aHeuristic_tpLengths <- rbind(aHeuristic_sin, aHeuristic_tin, aHeuristic_sho, 
                           aHeuristic_med, aHeuristic_lon, aHeuristic_vlo)

aHeuristic_tpLengths <- aHeuristic_tpLengths %>%
  left_join(touchpoint_groups, by = "Length")

aHeuristic_tpLengths$all_conversions <- total_conversions
aHeuristic_tpLengths$rate_ft <- aHeuristic_tpLengths$first_touch / aHeuristic_tpLengths$conversion_count * 100
aHeuristic_tpLengths$rate_lt <- aHeuristic_tpLengths$last_touch / aHeuristic_tpLengths$conversion_count * 100
aHeuristic_tpLengths$rate_ln <- aHeuristic_tpLengths$linear_touch / aHeuristic_tpLengths$conversion_count * 100

aHeuristic_tpLengths$Length <- factor(aHeuristic_tpLengths$Length,
                                   levels = c("Singular", "Tiny", "Short", "Medium", "Long", "Very Long"))

rm(aHeuristic_lon, aHeuristic_med, aHeuristic_sho, aHeuristic_sin, aHeuristic_tin, aHeuristic_vlo, 
   heuristic_array_lengths)
```

### Data-Driven Models

Logistic Regression

```{r regression, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
DataA_train$touchpoint_length <- factor(DataA_train$touchpoint_length,
                                         ordered = FALSE)

aLog_tpL <- glm(conversion ~ GD + GS + FO + MI + MF + FD + FE + GY + 
                  relevel(touchpoint_length, ref = "Singular"),
                 data = DataA_train,
                 family = binomial(link = "logit"))
summary(aLog_tpL)
```

First-order Markov Chain

```{r bad, echo = F, message = F}
touchpoint_groups <- DataA_train %>%
  filter(conversion == "1") %>%
  count(touchpoint_length, name = "conversion_count") %>%
  rename(Length = touchpoint_length)

lengths <- c("Singular", "Tiny", "Short", "Medium", "Long", "Very Long")

markov_array_lengths <- set_names(lengths) %>%
  map(\(category) {
    DataA_train %>%
      filter(touchpoint_length == category) %>%
      markov_model(
        var_path = "path",
        var_conv = "conversion",
        var_null = "null_conversion",
        out_more = TRUE
      )
  })

aMarkov_sin <- markov_array_lengths[["Singular"]]$result
aMarkov_tin <- markov_array_lengths[["Tiny"]]$result
aMarkov_sho <- markov_array_lengths[["Short"]]$result
aMarkov_med <- markov_array_lengths[["Medium"]]$result
aMarkov_lon <- markov_array_lengths[["Long"]]$result
aMarkov_vlo <- markov_array_lengths[["Very Long"]]$result

aMarkov_sin$Length <- "Singular"
aMarkov_tin$Length <- "Tiny"
aMarkov_sho$Length <- "Short"
aMarkov_med$Length <- "Medium"
aMarkov_lon$Length <- "Long"
aMarkov_vlo$Length <- "Very Long"

aMarkov_tpLengths <- rbind(aMarkov_sin, aMarkov_tin, aMarkov_sho, 
                           aMarkov_med, aMarkov_lon, aMarkov_vlo)

aMarkov_tpLengths <- aMarkov_tpLengths %>%
  left_join(touchpoint_groups, by = "Length")

aMarkov_tpLengths$all_conversions <- total_conversions
aMarkov_tpLengths$rate <- aMarkov_tpLengths$total_conversions / aMarkov_tpLengths$conversion_count * 100

aMarkov_tpLengths$Length <- factor(aMarkov_tpLengths$Length,
                                   levels = c("Singular", "Tiny", "Short", "Medium", "Long", "Very Long"))

rm(aMarkov_lon, aMarkov_med, aMarkov_sho, aMarkov_sin, aMarkov_tin, aMarkov_vlo, markov_array_lengths)
```

Combine

```{r more combine}
model4.3.2a <- left_join(aHeuristic_tpLengths, aMarkov_tpLengths, by = c("channel_name", "Length", "conversion_count", "all_conversions"))

model4.3.2a <- model4.3.2a %>%
  select(-first_touch, -last_touch, -linear_touch, -all_conversions, -total_conversions)
  
new_names <- c("Channel", "Length", "Group Conversion Total",
               "first_touch", "last_touch", "linear_touch", "markov_touch")

names(model4.3.2a) <- new_names

```

```{r regression, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# Significant channels: Search, Organic, Instagram, Facebook, Email

coefficient_names <- c("Intercept", "Display", "Seach",
                       "Organic", "Instagram", "Facebook",
                       "Direct", "Email", "Youtube")

# Insignificant channels do not have coefficient = 0 [Display, Direct, Youtube]

# Breakdown of math

B_0 = cLog$coefficients[1] # Intercept coefficient

# x = B_0 + B_Ck

Data_Log$GD <- Data_Log$GD * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + cLog_coefficients$coefficient[1])))^(-1)

Data_Log$MI <- Data_Log$MI * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + cLog_coefficients$coefficient[4])))^(-1)

Data_Log$MF <- Data_Log$MF * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + cLog_coefficients$coefficient[5])))^(-1)

Data_Log$MI <- Data_Log$MI / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$FD <- Data_Log$FD / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$FE <- Data_Log$FE / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$GY <- Data_Log$GY / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

logreg_count <- colSums(Data_Log[,6:13])
logreg_touch <- logreg_count / sum(logreg_count) * 100
show(logreg_touch)
```

First-order Markov Chain

```{r markov, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

                        var_path = 'path_col',
```

## 4.3.3 Path Granulate

```{r Pareto G, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# 80:20 split -- 80% Training & 20% Testing
  # All user sessions kept together.
set.seed(99)
users <- unique(DataG$user_id)
n_train_users <- floor(0.80 * length(users))

# Retry if the random split leaves the test set with only one outcome
for (attempt in 1:1000) {
  train_users <- sample(users, size = n_train_users)

  train_rows <- DataG$user_id %in% train_users
  test_rows  <- !train_rows

  if (length(unique(DataG$conversion[test_rows])) == 2) {
    break
  }
}

if (length(unique(DataG$conversion[test_rows])) < 2) {
  stop("Could not create a test set containing both conversions and non-conversions.")
}

DataG_train <- DataG[train_rows, ]
DataG_test  <- DataG[test_rows, ]
```

```{r heuristic, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# Last-Touch Attribution

# Linear Attribution
```

### Data-Driven Models

Logistic Regression

```{r regression, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
Data_Log <- DataG_train %>%
  select(-first_touchpoint,
         -last_touchpoint,
         -time_till_session_end,
         -customer_conversion_count,
         -customer_journey_count,
         -customer_conversion_rate,
         -null_conversion,
         -returning,
         -touchpoint_length)

gLog <- glm(conversion ~ Free + Ggle + Meta,
                 data = DataG_train,
                 family = binomial(link = "logit"))
summary(gLog)

# Significant channels: Search, Organic, Instagram, Facebook, Email

coefficient_names <- c("Intercept", "Free", "Google", "Meta")

coefficient_names_abv <- c("B__0", "Free", "Ggle", "Meta")

significant <- c(1, 1, 1, 1)

gLog_coefficients <- data.frame(name = coefficient_names,
                                name_abv = coefficient_names_abv,
                                coefficient = gLog$coefficients, 
                                significant)

gLog_coefficients <- gLog_coefficients[-1, ] # Removes Intercept Row

# Insignificant channels do not have coefficient = 0 [Display, Direct, Youtube]
gLog_coefficients$coefficient[gLog_coefficients$significant == 0] <- 0 

# Breakdown of math

B_0 = gLog$coefficients[1] # Intercept coefficient

# x = B_0 + B_Ck
# p_ij_hat == path channel count * (1 + exp(-x))^(-1)
Data_Log$Free <- Data_Log$Free * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + gLog_coefficients$coefficient[1])))^(-1)

Data_Log$Ggle <- Data_Log$Ggle * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + gLog_coefficients$coefficient[2])))^(-1)

Data_Log$Meta <- Data_Log$Meta * (1 + exp(-(B_0 + gLog_coefficients$coefficient[3])))^(-1)

Data_Log <- Data_Log %>%
  mutate(attribution_sum = rowSums(.[6:8]))

# a_ij_hat == p_ij_hat / SUM(p_ir_hat) * y_i [= 1 or 0]
Data_Log$Free <- Data_Log$Free / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$Ggle <- Data_Log$Ggle / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

Data_Log$Meta <- Data_Log$Meta / Data_Log$attribution_sum * Data_Log$conversion

logreg_count <- colSums(Data_Log[,6:8])
logreg_touch <- logreg_count / sum(logreg_count) * 100
show(logreg_touch)
```

First-order Markov Chain

```{r markov, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
gMarkov$all_conversions <- total_conversions

gModel <- gModel %>%
  rename(markov_touch = `gMarkov$rate`)

gTrans <- markov_array$transition_matrix
```

# Analysis

```{r ROC AUC, echo = F}
# Keep rows with complete outcome and predictors
predictor <- c("GD", "GS", "FO", "MI", "MF", "FD", "FE", "GY")
required <- c("path", "conversion", predictor)

DataA_trainROC <- DataA_train[complete.cases(DataA_train[, required]), required]
DataA_testROC <- DataA_test[complete.cases(DataA_test[, required]), required]

# -------------------------
# 1. Logistic regression
# -------------------------

logit_model <- glm(
  conversion ~ GD + GS + FO + MI + MF + FD + FE + GY,
  data = DataA_trainROC,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

logit_prob <- predict(logit_model, newdata = DataA_testROC, type = "response")

# -------------------------
# 2. First-order Markov model
# -------------------------

# Assumes path values look like: "Google > Email > Direct"
# Change this if your path uses another separator.
path_separator <- "\\s*>\\s*"

get_channels <- function(path) {
  channels <- trimws(strsplit(as.character(path), path_separator)[[1]])
  channels[nzchar(channels)]
}

fit_markov <- function(DataA_trainROC, smoothing = 0.5) {
  paths <- lapply(DataA_trainROC$path, get_channels)
  channel_states <- unique(unlist(paths))
  
  if (length(channel_states) == 0) {
    stop("No channels found. Check the path format and separator.")
  }
  
  conv_state <- ".__CONVERSION__."
  no_conv_state <- ".__NO_CONVERSION__."
  states <- c(channel_states, conv_state, no_conv_state)
  
  counts <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = length(states),
    ncol = length(states),
    dimnames = list(states, states)
  )
  
  # Count each channel-to-channel or channel-to-outcome transition
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(DataA_trainROC))) {
    terminal <- if (DataA_trainROC$conversion[i] == 1) {
      conv_state
    } else {
      no_conv_state
    }
    
    sequence <- c(paths[[i]], terminal)
    
    if (length(sequence) >= 2) {
      for (j in seq_len(length(sequence) - 1)) {
        counts[sequence[j], sequence[j + 1]] <-
          counts[sequence[j], sequence[j + 1]] + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Smooth channel transition rows and make outcome states absorbing
  P <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = length(states),
    ncol = length(states),
    dimnames = list(states, states)
  )
  
  for (state in channel_states) {
    row_counts <- counts[state, ] + smoothing
    P[state, ] <- row_counts / sum(row_counts)
  }
  
  P[conv_state, conv_state] <- 1
  P[no_conv_state, no_conv_state] <- 1
  
  # Calculate eventual conversion probability from each channel
  Q <- P[channel_states, channel_states, drop = FALSE]
  R <- P[channel_states, c(conv_state, no_conv_state), drop = FALSE]
  
  absorption <- solve(diag(length(channel_states)) - Q, R)
  conversion_prob <- absorption[, conv_state]
  names(conversion_prob) <- channel_states
  
  list(conversion_prob = conversion_prob)
}

markov_model_fit <- fit_markov(DataA_trainROC)

# Score each test journey using its last channel
train_conversion_rate <- mean(DataA_trainROC$conversion)

markov_prob <- vapply(DataA_testROC$path, function(path) {
  channels <- get_channels(path)
  
  if (length(channels) == 0) {
    return(train_conversion_rate)
  }
  
  last_channel <- tail(channels, 1)
  p <- markov_model_fit$conversion_prob
  
  if (last_channel %in% names(p)) {
    unname(p[last_channel])
  } else {
    # Fallback for a channel not seen in training
    train_conversion_rate
  }
}, numeric(1))

# -------------------------
# Compare ROC AUC
# -------------------------

roc_logit <- roc(
  response = DataA_testROC$conversion,
  predictor = logit_prob,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

roc_markov <- roc(
  response = DataA_testROC$conversion,
  predictor = markov_prob,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

auc_comparison <- data.frame(
  model = c("Logistic regression", "First-order Markov"),
  test_auc = c(as.numeric(auc(roc_logit)), as.numeric(auc(roc_markov)))
)

auc_comparison[order(-auc_comparison$test_auc), ]

# Plot both ROC curves
plot(roc_logit, col = paletteer::paletteer_d("MoMAColors::Abbott")[1], lwd = 2,
     main = "Test ROC Curves")
plot(roc_markov, col = paletteer::paletteer_d("MoMAColors::Abbott")[2], lwd = 2, add = TRUE)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray")

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c(
    paste0("LogReg Att Model AUC = ", round(auc(roc_logit), 3)),
    paste0("Markov Att Model AUC = ", round(auc(roc_markov), 3))
  ),
  col = paletteer::paletteer_d("MoMAColors::Abbott")[c(1,2)],
  lwd = 2
)
```
